# Trident Electric Pro

> Trident Electric Pro is a residential and commercial electrical contractor providing electrical repairs, installations, wiring, panel upgrades, lighting, EV charger installation, generators, surge protection, smart home electrical services, heater electrical work, new home electrical work, additions, remodeling, pool and hot tub electrical services, commercial electrical services, and multifamily electrical services.

## Service Areas

Trident Electric Pro has location pages organized by state and city.

State location hubs are available under:

https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/

Individual city pages use the following URL structure:

https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/{state}/{city}-home-electrician

Examples:

- https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/alabama/
- https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/alabama/adamsville-home-electrician
- https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/alabama/bessemer-home-electrician
- https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/arizona/
- https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/arizona/phoenix-home-electrician
- https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/arkansas/
- https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/arkansas/little-rock-home-electrician
- https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/california/
- https://tridentelectricpro.com/locations/california/los-angeles-home-electrician

The complete location URL inventory is provided in the site's XML sitemap.

## Business Focus

Trident Electric Pro focuses on electrical contracting rather than HVAC services. Relevant electrical work includes repairs, troubleshooting, installations, wiring, rewiring, panels, service upgrades, lighting, switches, outlets, heaters, EV chargers, generators, surge protection, smart home electrical systems, pools and hot tubs, new construction, additions, remodeling, commercial properties, and multifamily properties.
